The '''Cerebral Citadel''' is a sub-location of the {{Zone|Walk of Fame}}. It can be entered by showing {{NPCSprite|Obo}} {{Item|Shen's Ringalia}}.

== Features ==
The '''Cerebral Citadel''' features a few attractions.

=== Shen's Hive Mind ===
There are {{Green|7}} stone buttons on the back wall and {{Green|2}} wooden buttons. The left wooden button resets the sequence, and the right wooden button controls which sequence to play. There are a total of {{Green|5}} sequences to play, with the third awarding the {{Item|Celestial Timecharm}} and the fifth awarding the {{Item|Golden Belt}}.

To complete a sequence, all {{Item|Redstone Lamp}}s must be lit up by clicking each lamp's respective stone button: clicking a button while the lamp is off will turn it on and vice versa. Additionally, flipping a lamp will flip other lamps in all sequences except the first. The sequence of lamps needed for each sequence can be seen below:

=== Connections ===
The '''Cerebral Citadel''' can be entered through {{zone|The Vents}} from the {{zone|Wizardman Bureau}}.

== Trivia ==
* Each minigame reveals that multiple Shens live across universes and are gathering together to form a being of unparalleled greatness.
* Each Shen is named after a process in creating the ''Magnus Opus'' or ''Great Work'' in the context of alchemy, in order to create the ''philosopher's stone'' in {{green|4}} stages : 
**(1) the ''nigredo'' or blackening, (2) the ''albedo'' or whitening, (3) the ''citrinitas'' or yellowing and (4) the ''rubedo'' or reddening.
** Their colors, however, do not match the stage they're named after.
